analysis: Bounded static LLVM disassembly and historical navigation sources; no Windows executable execution or upload.

navigationSource.warning: Archive contains later changes; only the observations explicitly tied to addresses below are corroborated against the pinned binary.

observations.fact: IF:B requires three arguments and resolves positive/negative string-cell references before passing the path and repeat value to the custom-picture definition.
MO:O and MO:U use distinct one-bit fields. Assignment retains the low bit; numeric2 is false and3 true.

navigationContracts: erm decoded NewMesMan: numeric-1 clears a monster/event message. LE:M1 supports source string-cell read/write.
erm decoded HE:S: standard two-argument source skill index0..27 and byte level; this port admits only visible standard levels0..3.
erm decoded HE:K: default no-argument native hero removal.
erm decoded UN:S / common ShowArea: native fog reveal by position, owner and radius.
erm decoded LE:L/I and structs: one-visit/computer activation bits.
implementation: IF:B/P static illustrations use the existing native query, media lookup and responsive form; one acknowledgement, zoom closure isolated from the underlying query.
HE:S resolves original skills through the WoG bridge, queries native levels and updates native secondary skills. HE:K uses native removal and configured loss checks.
MO:U updates real flight policy; MO:O low-bit assignment is corrected. One-argument M-1 clears messages. MO four-coordinate form with the original ignored flag1 is admitted.
LE:M1 reads/writes actual event text; LE:L updates both removeAfterVisit and reward.removeObject so native completion really consumes the event. LE:I updates computer activation.
UN:S with an explicit existing player reveals native fog and updates the real minimap.
limitations: Repeated/video media, external string tables and unsupported IF:B modes remain unadmitted.
Hidden secondary skills beyond eight visible slots, nonstandard skill levels and skill-slot reordering are not implemented.
Global-message-number copying in MO:M/LE:M and all-player UN:S owner selectors remain unadmitted.
These private native controls and the three initial original encounters do not validate complete original quests, combat scripts, wins or transfers. All original campaigns remain disabled.
